nodes.title: Foam peak stresses read as the average over a 1 mm sphere
nodes.text: Element stresses at a bonded corner are averaged over a sphere of radius 1 mm round the peak element before comparing with the coupon allowable
nodes.basis: XPS cells are 0.1-0.3 mm; a continuum stress below a few cells is not what the coupon allowable measures. 1 mm is below every TCD length estimated for PS foams (several mm), so the average is conservative; the element peak is reported beside it
